mentions.name: Thumb-sized keyboard built from scratch
mentions.description: A thumb-sized keyboard designed and prototyped from scratch, including the author's first PCB layouts, intended as an alternative to salvaged BlackBerry keyboards used in handheld computer builds.
mentions.problem: Most handheld computer projects rely on salvaged BlackBerry keyboards, which are becoming harder to find.
mentions.source_excerpt: so also on a bit of a side quest to build a thumb-sized keyboard from scratch. Got me into laying out and prototyping my first PCBs and learning about how these things are made
